name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation of women and girls in Afghanistan following the Taliban’s adoption of the Criminal Procedure Code for Courts
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the Taliban's new Criminal Procedure Code for Courts. It says this code legalises domestic violence, punishes women who seek protection, allows flogging and the death penalty without fair trials, and leaves women with no lawyers or judges to turn to. The Parliament calls on the Taliban to repeal the code and asks the European Union to sanction Taliban leaders, keep refusing to recognise the Taliban as a government, and give more aid to Afghan women.

- The code is condemned; the Taliban are asked to repeal it.
- It affects Afghan women and girls, who lose all legal protection.
- Next: the European Union is urged to sanction Taliban leaders and fund Afghan women's groups.
